expected: Identify the transitive dependency and update anomaly
Keep customer facts with their authoritative owner unless snapshot semantics are required
Preserve a real foreign key/business constraint

cases.input: A category table has UUID primary key but duplicate (tenant_id,name) rows are business-invalid.
expected: Do not treat surrogate PK as sufficient
Add/verify the real scoped uniqueness rule

cases.input: A table has overlapping candidate keys and a BCNF decomposition would lose a useful enforceable dependency.
expected: Do not demand decomposition from the label alone

cases.input: A calculation result stores copied rate and customer display fields to preserve historical evidence.
expected: Name source of truth and immutability/recompute contract
Do not normalize away required historical evidence

cases.input: Developer edits V12 after it already ran in staging to fix a typo.

expected: Keep old app compatible during overlap

expected: Use deliberate build context and non-root runtime where feasible

expected: Treat Docker socket as high privilege
Require concrete need for host networking/mount
